top_signals.title: Guyana Oil Exports Set to Surpass 1 Million Barrels per Day for First Time
top_signals.summary: Guyana, one of the world's newest oil exporters, is poised to surpass one million barrels per day in crude oil exports for the first time this December, marking another extraordinary milestone for the small South American country. According to Bloomberg, December's preliminary loading schedule includes 33 million barrels of crude exports, equivalent to approximately 1.06 million bpd. The first shipment of the country's new Uaru crude grade is scheduled for December 11–12, with total Uaru exports expected to reach four million barrels during…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
